2121654544581165122.en_summary: (Reposted by @carlquintanilla) Steve Eisman says CoreWeave's three founders sold over $3 billion of stock since IPO and bought back zero, calling the management team dicey. Nvidia invested $2 billion in CoreWeave and Nebius; next CEO after Jensen Huang may not be so quick to write checks to neoclouds. Quoted Dylan Patel on Nvidia board evidence on chip smuggling as Singapore revenue no longer reported.
2121654544581165122.zh_summary: （由@carlquintanilla轉發）Steve Eisman稱CoreWeave三位創始人自IPO以來出售超過30億美元股票且回購為零，稱管理團隊不可靠。Nvidia向CoreWeave和Nebius投資20億美元；黃仁勳之後的下一任CEO可能不會那麼快向neoclouds開支票。引用Dylan Patel稱Nvidia董事會有芯片走私證據，因為不再報告新加坡收入。

ticker_notes.CRWV: founders sold over $3B since IPO, zero buybacks, dicey management; NVDA $2B investment at risk

2121653675529502973.en_summary: @tastyliveshow notes that two weeks ago if you heard Jensen Huang would be out at Nvidia, a midterm sweep would hit data centers, and a major tech outage would follow, you would not have guessed the market sits 2% from all-time highs. @jam_croissant: “No, of course not.” That’s the power of structural flows.
2121653675529502973.zh_summary: @tastyliveshow指出兩週前如果你聽到黃仁勳將離開Nvidia、中期選舉會打擊數據中心、以及重大科技中斷將隨之而來，你不會猜到市場距離歷史高點僅2%。@jam_croissant：「當然不會。」這就是結構性資金流的力量。

2121653390786883904.en_summary: @firesidealpha: Ben Thompson says Nvidia was an F1 car built around Jensen Huang, and the only company comparable is Apple. Ten years ago a gaming company, five years ago gaming/Bitcoin. Moves so fast with yearly cadence of releases. Quoted Ben Thompson arguing chip ban is insane policy that will destroy America’s chip industry long term.
2121653390786883904.zh_summary: @firesidealpha：Ben Thompson稱Nvidia是圍繞黃仁勳打造的F1賽車，唯一可比的公司是Apple。十年前是遊戲公司，五年前是遊戲/比特幣公司。移動如此快速，年發布節奏。引用Ben Thompson認為芯片禁令是瘋狂政策，長期將摧毀美國芯片產業。

2121652930961166538.en_summary: @wallstengine: More than 100,000 people have signed an open letter urging Nvidia’s board to reinstate Jensen Huang, including 5,258 self-identified current employees (roughly 12.5% of workforce). Elon Musk is among the signers. Site does not verify identities.
2121652930961166538.zh_summary: @wallstengine：超過10萬人簽署公開信敦促Nvidia董事會恢復黃仁勳職位，其中包括5258名自稱為現任員工（約佔員工總數12.5%）。Elon Musk也是簽署者之一。該網站不驗證身份。

2121651204031959545.en_summary: (Reposted by @JohnSpall247) @bgurley: This is not insane at all. 1/ all D&O programs will have a cap. At NVIDIA's size and with their cash position, its easier to self-insure. 2/ The IRR required by the insurance company would be above their cost of capital, so they would be giving away money. 3/ Large D&O programs attract litigants. You may not know this, but you have to disclose you have it.
2121651204031959545.zh_summary: （由@JohnSpall247轉發）@bgurley：這一點也不瘋狂。1/ 所有D&O計劃都有上限。以NVIDIA的規模和現金狀況，自保更容易。2/ 保險公司要求的IRR高於其資本成本，所以他們會在送錢。3/ 大型D&O計劃會吸引訴訟人。你可能不知道，但你必須披露你有它。
